content.description:
At EpochSec, I provide Cyber Security Support for the Cardano and Crypto Communities. My name is Kyle (or Holymacaroni on social media). I am currently running my Fund9 Catalyst Approved project, "Cyber Security Community Support". The overall premise is to provide free services (free to the individual or team), funded by Catalyst, to help the community better protect themselves and continue to spread awareness.

My goal is to enable individuals and teams to better protect themselves online:

I achieve this through a variety of methods. The idea is to give multiple options, as everyone prefers different ways of consuming information.

You can also check out my youtube channel. Just search for epochsec. And my additional twitter account is epochsec_io.
